method.exactFingerprint: Ordered root and slash-bass pitch classes relative to the first chord root, exact quality pitch-class set, and exact duration in source bars. Enharmonic spellings are pitch-equivalent; quality, slash bass and time remain separate.
method.scaledFingerprint: Same structure, with durations divided by total passage duration. This only supports a spelling decision; it does not establish semantic identity.
method.rootPattern: Ordered directed roots modulo 12; used only with independent OCR and source dictionary spelling. It does not erase preserved quality or timing variations.
method.boundaries: Source row segments are compared as segments, including source-clipped continuations. Prefix comparisons are explicitly separate from full equality.
method.safety: No generic yen replacement, fuzzy matching, Roman case folding, or chord-structure equality is applied at runtime. Only reviewed literal aliases are used. Full source labels, chords and timings remain unchanged.
